about.heading: About me
paragraphs: i'm a computer science undergrad at penn state building backend systems, privacy tools, and graphics software.

i’m interested in backend development, distributed systems, and computer graphics, and mainly work with go, python, and rust. lately, i’m curious about running ai models locally and in the browser, coordinating teams of coding agents, and exploring world models and learned simulations.
outside of code, i like bouldering, hiking, pickleball, chess, video games, basketball, football, and reading. feel free to reach out about anything, and have fun exploring the page.

projects.title: PrivateAI Gateway
projects.description: An LLM gateway that detects and redacts personal information and credentials before prompts reach external model providers. Configurable policies can allow, redact, tokenize, or block sensitive data, with support for concurrent requests and streaming responses.
projects.details: Built in Go with reversible tokenization to restore authorized values in model responses.

projects.title: Personal Website
projects.description: This portfolio, with a minimal reading view and an interactive 3D solar system. Fly between sections or explore a browser adaptation of my Rust Space Simulator, with adjustable bodies, gravity, and simulation speed.

projects.title: Kale Space Program
projects.description: A real-time 3D solar-system simulation written in Rust. Celestial bodies move under gravity, with GPU-accelerated rendering and a navigable camera.
projects.details: The source includes a Barnes–Hut octree, a WGSL gravity compute shader, a Sun and eight planets, and an asteroid belt initialized with 10,000 bodies. A desktop control panel exposes simulation speed and velocity-vector controls.
projects.note: The 3D browser playground uses the original rendering shaders and camera controls, a Rust WebAssembly octree, and adapted WebGPU gravity. The original desktop repository remains unchanged.

projects.title: URL Shortener
projects.description: A URL shortening service with click tracking and an analytics dashboard. A FastAPI backend stores links in PostgreSQL and caches frequently used redirects in Redis, with a React frontend for viewing link activity.

projects.title: ApplyNow
projects.description: A Python tool for automating LinkedIn job applications. Uses Selenium for browser interactions, BeautifulSoup for parsing pages, and pandas for working with application data.

experience.description: worked on the endpoint security team, building an audit event system in go and kafka to record changes to firewall policies. i connected policy workflows to the event pipeline across api endpoints and cloud regions, and fixed concurrency bugs that affected reliability.

built a quiz system for a financial literacy platform, working across the react frontend and node.js backend. i also streamlined how the app retrieved questions from the database and sped up docker builds to make development and deployment smoother.

researched how distributed servers respond to denial-of-service attacks using controlled traffic simulations and wireshark. i analyzed network traffic to understand tcp/ip behavior under attack and documented mitigation techniques and protocol-level defenses.
